integrity: Proof is analytic, with reproducible finite checks; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact ridge probability requires nonpositive cross facet-normal products; for arbitrary simplices it is a strict upper bound. Mean-normal inequality need not be globally sharp in the presence of multiple obtuse facet pairs; complete total-normal distribution is not claimed. Historical priority is provisional.
title: An exact ridge-normal obstruction and a quantitative mean-normal deficit for simplices
